status: retrospective revision; set before inspecting new scores
selection: maximize mean validation macro recall over inner splits. Resolve ties by order of profile and then penalty in this file.
DTD: outer official test unchanged. Select using official train vs official validation after purging outer-test exact groups from both and validation groups from inner train. Refit on the retained union.
KTH: for each outer specimen letter, rotate the other three as inner validation; fit on the other two letters. Refit on three letters.
Flowers: 3 inner source splits. Shuffle integer source credit groups with RNG seed, round-robin split them into three disjoint folds. Fit once on all TF source images and predict both later target collections. No target used for selection.
Q: q=p_s*s+p_w*w+p_c*c. Q=(2*q+0.75*q*q)/3.25. For other methods q determines the common linear component. Two-product coefficients remain 0.25 and 0.5; U weights each cross-product 0.25.
numeric: DTD all official splits, native squared radii and ordinal ranks as reference. Tie-adjusted midranks with constant zero correlation to other coordinates and unit diagonal; separate always grid beta vs undefined log-beta set to zero at q mean <= 1e-4. Compare diagonal-only scatter retaining original radial/scale, magnitude wavelets, and coordinate-group deletions. Fixed published ridge = 1. Terms and nuisance rules unchanged except named intervention.
inference: report exploratory paired conditional CIs for tuned W minus Add,U,Q (Bonferroni family 3 per corpus; DTD exact-group multipliers / flowers images within class / KTH specimens within class); all scores and fold choices retained.
